text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day. Daiwa Scarlet called me 
out first thing in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, right on schedule. Well then, shall 
we head out?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Off to shop for training supplies!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...? Isn't it obvious? We only just 
decided on our goal, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there are so many people today. 
Looks like there's even a line forming."
choice_data_list: Well, it is Valentine's Day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. So this line is to buy 
chocolates—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's nothing! Let's hurry up and go 
shopping!

And I ended up tagging along on Daiwa 
Scarlet's shopping trip—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We sure bought a lot. One way or 
another, it's already gotten this late.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'll go buy us some drinks. 
You just wait right here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Sure, why not. Consider it thanks for 
accompanying me on today's shopping trip.

And Daiwa Scarlet headed to the 
registerâ
(—*plunk*)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Here's your cocoa. You need something 
sweet when you're tired, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It does contain cacao, so technically it 
counts as chocolate, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, sorry it was so makeshift.
choice_data_list: I'm happy just knowing you feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

The hot cocoa I drank that day tasted so 
much sweeter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Here's your coffee. And also...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...That coffee looks a bit bitter, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I bought some chocolate too, just in case 
it wasn't sweet enough.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...If you need to, why don't you dissolve 
it in that coffee? You can just eat it as 
is, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...You're welcome.

"And so, I spent a bittersweet Valentine's 
Day with Daiwa Scarlet."
